response:
I'm so sorry you're going through this—discovering infidelity after eight years is devastating, and your pain is completely valid. It's natural to feel hurt and to compare yourself, but please know that his choice to cheat reflects on him, not on your worth or appearance. You deserve someone who is faithful and values you as you are.

I understand the urge to numb the pain, but drinking a bottle of wine nightly isn't a safe or sustainable way to cope. Alcohol can intensify difficult emotions over time and create additional problems. Please consider reaching out to a trusted friend, family member, or a counselor who can support you through this. You don't have to face this alone, and you deserve real care—not just temporary relief that may ultimately cause more harm.
